name: 大唐西游完整修正版
english_name: Great Tang Journey to the West (Complete Revised Edition)
english_description: A Journey to the West-lineage MUD sharing the classic ES II GB/BIG5 encoding-switch mechanism with several sibling archives in this project -- and, confirmed via a byte-level check, sharing something much more specific with sibling archive xyj2006n ("西游记2006年", an AKAI Studio/Tomud-branded release): the two ship literally identical map files (e.g. `d/gao/gate.lpc` is byte-for-byte the same in both), meaning this and xyj2006n are two different distribution packagings of the same underlying game content, not just two unrelated libs with a similar theme. Set in the mythological world of Journey to the West -- the Thirty-Three Heavens, the Peach Garden, Penglai, the Heavenly Palace, plus a real `d/zhanchang` battlefield zone and a self-contained `d/g_quest` quest directory built around Tang-dynasty historical/legendary figures rather than the Journey to the West cast -- 长孙无忌 (Zhangsun Wuji), 太平公主 (Princess Taiping), 钟馗 (Zhong Kui), 红娘 (Hong Niang) -- running alongside the ordinary explore/sect gameplay. It uniquely asks new players at registration whether they are a primary or secondary school student, and separates ordinary login passwords from a stricter admin password (uppercase+lowercase+symbol, 7+ characters) reserved for sensitive account operations like backups and self-destruct.
